paragraphs: The Freelander Si4 was introduced during the L359 generation (2006–2014) as the petrol option in the range, using Ford's 2.0-litre EcoBoost turbocharged four-cylinder engine. This is the same engine family found in a range of Ford and Volvo products of the era, offering 240PS in this application. It was the performance-oriented petrol choice alongside the diesel Td4, eD4 and SD4 variants. The Freelander was discontinued in 2014, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Land Rover Freelander Si4 Engine Compatibility The Freelander Si4 uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre turbo petrol engine, fitted exclusively to the L359 generation. Because this engine has specific cooling and timing chain requirements, we confirm your exact specification by registration before quoting or supplying any work. This protects you from compatibility issues that can arise from assuming parts from other Freelander variants will fit. How much does a Land Rover Freelander Si4 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £1,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Freelander Si4? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine spec before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild Ford EcoBoost Freelander Si4 engines? Yes. We replace timing chain components, coolant system parts and gaskets as standard on every Freelander Si4 rebuild. Do you supply used Freelander Si4 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Freelander Si4 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Freelander Si4 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Freelander owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ford EcoBoost engines for every Freelander Si4 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Freelander Si4 from 2023 to present. The Ford EcoBoost features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ford EcoBoost V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ford EcoBoost rebuild.
